units.spec_capture_raw: dGamma_cap/d(E/T) as returned by urca_rel.spectra (code units) = T * dGamma_cap/dE
units.spec_capture_dGdE: dGamma_cap/dE = spec_capture_raw / T (same code units per MeV)
units.thermal_raw: E^2 f(E) shape reference at zero chemical potential, dimensionless
units.note: the raw spectra are NOT mutually comparable physical emission rates; each plotted curve is normalised to its own maximum (spec_* / max)
